name: http_request
description: A generic HTTP client that performs a GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE request to any http(s) URL and returns the status plus response text. Use to fetch page/API content, call REST endpoints, or talk to an MCP server URL (initialize, tools/list, tools/call via JSON-RPC body). Send whatever the target needs: any headers and any text or JSON body on any method.

method.description: HTTP method: GET (default), POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE.

url.description: Target URL, http:// or https:// only (any public or local MCP/server URL).

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers as string pairs (e.g. Authorization, Content-Type, MCP-Session-Id).

body.description: Optional request body on any method: raw text or JSON string (MCP JSON-RPC payload, REST data, form, XML). Empty means no body.
